title: Graph planes of a linear map: energy and tangential error controlled by the tilt |p_S - p_T|^2
statement:
For all n, l, every linear isometry q of R^{n+l} and every linear map D : R^n -> R^l with operator norm ||D|| <= 1, let S := span{q(graphPoint v (D v)) : v in R^n}, p := S.starProjection, T := rotatedPlane q = q(R^n x {0}), P := T.starProjection, and |A|^2 := hsNormSq A. Then (a) |D|^2 <= (l + 1/2) |p - P|^2; and (b) for every j in Fin l and all r, w in R^n with = (D v)_j for every v (r is the j-th row of D), |

- | <= |p - P|^2 ||w||, where e'_j := q(graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).
